mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_scheduled_task ORDER BY task_code ASC

SELECT * FROM system_scheduled_task WHERE enabled = 1 AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_run_at ASC, task_code ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE system_scheduled_task SET description = #{description}, cycle_type = #{cycleType}, interval_value = #{intervalValue}, interval_hours_part = #{intervalHoursPart}, interval_minutes_part = #{intervalMinutesPart}, time_of_day = #{timeOfDay}, day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek}, day_of_month = #{dayOfMonth}, month_of_year = #{monthOfYear}, enabled = #{enabled}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE task_code = #{taskCode}
